basic_info.description: Elegant Marina District Condo - Prime Location, Sophisticated Living. Offered at $1,649,000, this beautifully appointed 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo offers the best of San Francisco living in the coveted Marina District. With approximately 1,650 square feet of refined interior space, this residence seamlessly blends timeless character with modern comfort.        The bright, open floor plan features expansive windows and rich hardwood floors throughout. A spacious living area with a charming fireplace flows effortlessly into the dining spaceideal for both entertaining and everyday living. The updated kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and abundant cabinetry for all your culinary needs. The generously sized primary suite includes a walk-in closet with ample additional closet space and a well-appointed en-suite bathroom. Both additional bedrooms also feature walk-in closets, offering excellent storage and flexible use as guest rooms, home offices, or creative studios. Additional amenities include two dedicated parking spaces and private storage. Enjoy unparalleled access to the vibrant shops, restaurants, and cafes of Chestnut, Union, and Polk Streets, all just moments from your door.
